name: sdn-element-sync
description: SDN element-set sync (typed contracts 1.0: FlatBuffers only, no JSON). Pure C++ merge step of the SDN-AP data path; the host connectors move the bytes (p2p-discovery pulls a peer's latest dataset and its signed $PNV notice, flatsql-query reads the cache, storage-ingest writes it, the harness schedules), this module decides. Two lanes, one record type per theory lane: the SGP4 lane carries foreign $OMM as received, the element-set lane carries $OCM (SGP4XP and AP sets). Method "merge": ONE $QRP window Request (FROM_EPOCH_MS the cache window start = now minus the cache days, 7 days by default; AS_OF_MS now; TO_EPOCH_MS an optional upper bound; LIMIT an optional cap per lane that drops the oldest first) with each lane's sets read back from the cache ("cached" $OMM, "cached_ocm" $OCM) and the sets just pulled from a peer ("pulled" $OMM, "pulled_ocm" $OCM, accepted only beside a $PNV notice whose entries are all signature-verified). Per lane it drops sets whose EPOCH is before the window (expiry by epoch) and de-duplicates on the lane's key, a pulled set winning over a cached one: $OMM (NORAD_CAT_ID, OBJECT_ID, MEAN_ELEMENT_THEORY, ORIGINATOR, EPOCH); $OCM (METADATA.NORAD_CAT_ID, METADATA.INTERNATIONAL_DESIGNATOR, MEAN_ELEMENTS.MEAN_ELEMENT_THEORY, HEADER.ORIGINATOR, MEAN_ELEMENTS.EPOCH). It answers each lane's window snapshot sorted by its key ("omm", "ocm": size-prefixed streams of at most 4 MiB per frame, every record byte for byte), the sets not yet cached ("store", "store_ocm", for storage-ingest), one cutoff per lane on "expire" (a $QRP Request: SCHEMA_NAME OMM, then OCM; TO_EPOCH_MS the window start), the accepted $PNV notices byte for byte on "notice" (this module never signs and never alters a notice) and one $QRP Page of counts per lane on "summary" (SCHEMA_NAME OMM, then OCM). Refused by name, the whole call and no output: any record with USER_DEFINED_PARAMETERS (user-defined-parameters:<count>); an $OCM without MEAN_ELEMENTS (mean-elements-missing) or with MEAN_ELEMENT_THEORY UNSPECIFIED (mean-element-theory-unspecified). No hostcalls, no capabilities.

sequentialJustification.detail: One merge of the frames of one invocation on the calling thread; nothing survives the invocation and no thread is created.
